items.description: CLIP-style representations and embedding experiments. Architecture mismatches and incomplete dual-encoder documentation are noted.

items.note: RADIO/C-RADIO and SigLIP2/CLIP-style representation package, tagged for zero-shot image classification. Original NVIDIA weight terms apply.

items.title: Scientific Multimodal Interfaces
items.description: Scientific image and weather interfaces, with native dependencies and explicitly scoped component validation.

items.note: MKB Polaris/Swin weather-field encoder and decoder. Decoding depends on encoder caches and language hidden states. This is not an RGB codec, and global forecasting performance has not been evaluated.
S1-Omni vision tower, text-hidden-state alignment, Qwen-Image VAE, and DiT boundary modules. The language backbone and DiT attention/FFN generation core are excluded.

items.title: Unified Visual Components
items.description: Visual subsystems from unified understanding and generation models, including pixel interfaces, flow modules, and mixed component bundles.

items.note: Complete Harmon visual MAR, VAE, diffusion prediction/sampling head, and language-space projections. The Qwen language backbone is excluded.
HiDream-O1 vision/DeepStack modules, pixel input, and timestep/output interfaces. The shared language/flow backbone is excluded, so this package does not generate images independently.
ILLUME-X SigLIP vision tower, connector, flow interfaces, and its upstream BAGEL VAE dependency. The language/MoT backbone is excluded.
InternLumina-U2 multi-codebook input/output interfaces and AR head. The AToken tokenizer and shared diffusion backbone are separate dependencies.
FastViT/MobileCLIP, MCP, complete SANA, and DC-AE encoder/decoder. The Qwen language backbone is excluded. This is a mixed visual-component package, not a ViT-only or VAE-only export.
AIMv2 soft visual tokenizer, visual embedding table, and complete Yak flow/VAE branch. The understanding tokenizer is not a pixel VQ codec. The Qwen3 backbone is excluded.
PixelUMM image/video pixel input and output interfaces. The shared MoT backbone is excluded; this is not a standalone VAE or semantic encoder.
Native RGB input/output projections and timestep/noise interfaces. The shared MoT backbone is excluded; this is an interface bundle, not a standalone ViT, VAE, or generator.
SenseNova-Vision SigLIP tower, flow interfaces, and BAGEL VAE, distinct from SenseNova-U1.5. The shared MoT backbone is excluded.
Show-o2 semantic tower, fusion interfaces, ten-layer flow branch, and native Wan2.1 VAE. Complete generation still requires the matching Qwen backbone.

UniCom semantic compression/expansion and flow interfaces. The pixel decoder, FLUX VAE, and language backbone are excluded. The native aligner input-width mismatch is explicitly rejected rather than implicitly adapted.

InternVision, connector, custom DC-AE decoder, and complete SANA branch. Image encoding uses the vision tower rather than an RGB VAE. Loading requires the separately obtained upstream decoder source specified in the model card.

items.title: DiT & Visual Generation
items.description: Diffusion transformers, conditional decoders, and generation models, with their conditioning, codec, and sampling requirements.

items.note: Complete DeepGen-1.0 SD3 DiT and six-layer connector. The language backbone and VAE are excluded. Native conditioning and scheduling interfaces are required.
UniDDT-512 Noisy ViT and separate diffusion decoder. The Noisy ViT consumes FLUX VAE latents rather than RGB. Native Qwen3-VL conditioning and an external VAE are required.
UniPic2 Metaquery GRPO SD3 DiT and 24-layer conditioner. The full language model and VAE are excluded; native reference-image editing interfaces are retained.
UniSpace PR-DINOv2 class-conditional DiT and normalization statistics. This is an ImageNet-class generator, not the complete multimodal MoT or a text-conditioned generator.

PyTorch conversion of the authors' GenCeption 1.3B multitask checkpoint: Wan DiT, token heads, and official Wan VAE. Intended for geometry/depth tasks; this is not a Specialist-S benchmark checkpoint from the paper.

PyTorch conversion of the authors' GenCeption 14B multitask checkpoint: Wan DiT, token heads, and Wan VAE. This is not a Specialist-S benchmark checkpoint; native grouped-attention interfaces are required.
Open-Vision-Banana SANA multitask image-generation package. This is a generation-task model, distinct from standalone ViT or tokenizer exports.

Complete InternVL-U 20-layer generation DiT, including native conditioning and padding interfaces. The language backbone, vision tower and VAE are excluded. Preserve DPM flow sampling and three-branch CFG; validation uses synthetic CPU component fixtures.

items.title: Visual Tokenizers & VAEs
items.description: Discrete and continuous visual tokenizers, VAEs, and reconstruction modules, with decoder availability and latent conventions documented.

items.note: Apple AToken-So/D encoder, eight-codebook FSQ, semantic pooling, and pixel decoder. This is the upstream tokenizer used by InternLumina-U2, not a tokenizer newly trained by U2.
BitDance binary image tokenizer, D32/C128 variant, for image encoding and reconstruction.
Emu3.5 VQ visual tokenizer and codec components. The language backbone is excluded.
GEAR-IBQ image tokenizer and codec with a 16,384-entry codebook.
HydraTok understanding/generation visual tokenizer and pixel reconstruction components, retaining native latent representations and branch interfaces.
Gestalt-associated IBQ visual tokenizer with a 16,384-entry codebook, retaining native encoding, quantization, and pixel reconstruction interfaces.
Qwen-Image VAE used by InternVL-U, published separately from the understanding-side internvlu_vision_bridge.
Wan2.2 video VAE used by LANCE for pixel/video latent encoding and decoding. The LANCE understanding tower and generation backbone are excluded.

LLaDA2.0-Uni vision encoder, VQ modules, and auxiliary conditioning embeddings. Outputs token IDs; the separate diffusion renderer and image VAE are excluded, so this package does not directly reconstruct pixels.
LongCat-Next visual codec with residual vector quantization and pixel encoding/decoding. The full language model is excluded.
MammothModa2 MammothTok visual codec components. The complete unified-model backbone is excluded.
Continuous MingTok components from Ming-UniVision: encoding, semantic expansion, and pixel reconstruction. The language backbone and language-side latent prediction head are excluded.
RAEv2 DINOv3-L semantic encoder and reconstruction decoder, K7 general variant. This is a representation autoencoder rather than a conventional KL-VAE.
TokenFlow CLIP-B visual tokenizer with a 32K codebook and pixel encoder/decoder.
UniAR-RL BSQ encoder, binary visual tokens, and decoded visual features. Pixel rendering still requires the separate SD3.5 decoder and VAE.
UniSpace PR-DINOv2 unified tokenizer with 768-dimensional semantic features, 128-dimensional reconstruction features, and a pixel decoder. Paired with the matching class-conditional DiT.
UniTok Large visual tokenizer and reconstruction codec. The full language and generation backbones are excluded.
VILA-U 256px visual codec with residual quantization. The language backbone is excluded.
